stable.notes: Work follows every handoff: a session that has the work moves its card to Draft, and one that reports done with evidence moves it to QA, never to Complete. Every move can be undone. New sessions open as a tab in Claude, Codex or Cursor with the handoff filled in, so you can work in them beside COS; nothing sends until you press Send there. Includes 0.5.247. Pairs with server 6.58.0.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
